english.title: Fraudulently put unauthorised paper into ballot box at election
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), fraudulently put a paper, other than the ballot paper which you were authorised by law to put in, into a ballot box at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..), at a

(A)_[parliamentary]_
(B)_[local government]_

election, namely **(..SPECIFY ELECTION LOCATION..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 65(1)(d) and (4) of the Representation of the People Act 1983.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

other.penalty:
Summary: maximum 6 months imprisonment and/or a fine not exceeding level five on the standard scale.Time limit for prosecutions:
Complex see section 176Note
On the 12th March 2015, the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' Court was removed - as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
